content_sections.heading: Samagra Shiksha DNH DD Recruitment 2026 Overview

rows.details: Directorate of Education, U.T. Administration of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu (Samagra Shiksha)

content_sections.heading: Samagra Shiksha DNH DD Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Registration on each notified date is between 9:30 AM and 11:00 AM; no candidate will be permitted to appear after the closing time of registration. The notification does not specify a separate application submission deadline distinct from these walk-in dates.

content_sections.heading: Samagra Shiksha DNH DD Vacancy 2026 – Post & District Details
content_sections.text: There are 74 total vacancies across two posts. The Competent Authority reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of posts at any stage.

content_sections.heading: Samagra Shiksha DNH DD Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Secondary (Class XII or its equivalent) from a recognized board with at least 45% marks, in accordance with NCTE Regulations 2002, AND a Diploma in Nursery Teacher Education/Pre-School Education/Early Childhood Education Programme (D.E.C.Ed.) of not less than one year, or B.Ed. (Nursery) from an NCTE recognized institution. OR Senior Secondary with at least 45% marks and a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (by whatever name known), in accordance with NCTE Regulations, 2002. OR Senior Secondary with at least 50% marks and a 4-year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.). Candidates holding a Diploma in Elementary Education or B.El.Ed. from an NCTE recognized institution may also be considered for appointment as Pre-school Teacher, provided they mandatorily undergo a six-month Bridge Course in Nursery Teacher Education/Pre-School/Early Childhood Education Programme recognized by NCTE, within two years of such appointment. Secondary (Class X or its equivalent) from a recognized board with at least 45% marks.

content_sections.heading: Samagra Shiksha DNH DD Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: For both posts, the age limit is not exceeding 30 years. The upper age limit is relaxable as per Orders/Guidelines issued by the Central Government from time to time. The notification does not specify the exact reference date for age calculation.

content_sections.heading: Samagra Shiksha DNH DD Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: No TA/DA shall be payable to any candidate for attending the Walk-in Interview.

content_sections.heading: Samagra Shiksha DNH DD Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: No application fee is mentioned in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Samagra Shiksha DNH DD Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is conducted through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates report to the venue for registration within the prescribed window (9:30 AM to 11:00 AM) and are required to produce original and self-attested documents for verification. The notification does not specify a separate written test; candidature is subject to eligibility and document verification, and is liable to be cancelled at any stage if the information furnished is found false or the candidate is found ineligible.

content_sections.heading: How to Attend the Samagra Shiksha DNH DD Walk-in Interview
content_sections.text: Obtain the prescribed application form (available at the venue on the day of the Walk-in Interview, or use the enclosed format) Fill the application duly, selecting the post applied for (Pre-School Teacher or Caretaker/Helper) and the district (DNH, Daman, or Diu) Sign the declaration confirming that all information provided is true and that the post is contractual with no right to future regularization Report to the respective venue on the notified date between 9:30 AM and 11:00 AM for registration - no candidate will be permitted after the closing time Carry the original and one set of self-attested copies of: proof of date of birth; mark-sheets and passing certificates of all examinations passed; Diploma/Degree certificate; Aadhaar Card or other valid photo ID; Caste/Category certificate (if applicable); and one recent passport-size photograph

faq.question: Q1. What is Samagra Shiksha DNH DD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is Advertisement No. DNH-DD/DOE/SS/ECCE/RECRUITMENT/2026-27/3427 issued by the Directorate of Education, U.T. Administration of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu, for 74 Pre-School Teacher and Caretaker/Helper posts under Samagra Shiksha, on a Short Term Contract basis via Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are 74 vacancies - 22 Pre-School Teacher posts and 52 Caretaker/Helper (Female) posts.

faq.question: Q3. What are the walk-in interview dates?
faq.answer: 16 September 2026 (Pre-School Teacher, DNH), 17 September 2026 (Caretaker/Helper, DNH), and 18 September 2026 (Caretaker/Helper, Daman).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Pre-School Teacher?
faq.answer: Senior Secondary (Class XII) with at least 45% marks and a recognized Diploma/B.Ed. in Nursery/Pre-School/Elementary Education, or a 4-year B.El.Ed. with at least 50% marks, as detailed in the Eligibility section above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Caretaker/Helper?
faq.answer: Secondary (Class X or its equivalent) from a recognized board with at least 45% marks.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must not exceed 30 years of age, with relaxation available as per Central Government orders/guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the Pre-School Teacher or Caretaker/Helper posts?
faq.answer: There is no online application - eligible candidates must attend the Walk-in Interview at the scheduled venue and date with a filled application form and required original/self-attested documents.
